name: Institute of Business Management and Research, IPS Academy, Indore

programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA Core)
programs.feeNote: Derived: AFRC Madhya Pradesh lists a semester-wise fee of Rs 69,000 for 'IPS Academy, Institute of Business Management And Research, Indore MP' (M.B.A.) for both 2026-2027 and 2027-2028; 4 semesters x Rs 69,000 = Rs 2,76,000 (regulated fee; hostel/other charges not included). AFRC also lists two other IBMR entries (Knowledge Village and 'International Business') with fee shown as 0, and the separate Sanwer campus at Rs 29,000 per semester.
programs.intakeNote: NIRF 2025 data submitted by IBMR: sanctioned intake 540 for all PG 2-year programmes combined (2023-24). Programme-wise seats not published.
programs.placementNote: Median salary of placed PG-2-year graduates as submitted by IBMR for NIRF 2025: Rs 4,05,000 for 2023-24 (538 graduated, 406 placed); Rs 4,80,000 for 2022-23; Rs 5,25,000 for 2021-22. No NIRF 2026 file found on the institute site; no official average published.

selectionProcess.name: DTE Madhya Pradesh online counselling on CMAT merit
selectionProcess.detail: Per IBMR's MBA (Core) page, admission is on CMAT score. DTE MP Admission Rules 2026-27: graduation with min. 50% (45% for MP SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer); merit on the NTA CMAT common merit list; if seats remain vacant after round one, a further round may use the entrance-test rank and/or qualifying-exam marks.

selectionProcess.name: College Level Counselling (CLC)
selectionProcess.detail: Per IBMR's MBA (Core) page, CLC admissions are made on graduation percentage.

keyDates.notes: Admission via DTE MP counselling; 2027-28 schedule not published as of 2026-11-12.
